personality: 7 Dark-First Utility DARK with Brutalist Military structure
personality_one_liner: A heavy, dirty, post-apocalyptic cinematic HUD where survival metrics dominate and every UI element feels like bolted-on industrial military hardware.

spacing.rule: Generous safe areas for landscape orientation. HUD elements tightly hug the safe area boundaries. Keep center screen clear for 3D action.

do's: Use simple translucent black overlays (e.g., rgba(0,0,0,0.6)) for menus so the 3D scene remains visible behind the UI.
dont's: Do not use blur/glass effects as they cost heavy GPU performance, which is better reserved for the Three.js 3D arena rendering.

screens.name: Main Menu
screens.purpose: Entry point for the game featuring a cinematic 3D backdrop of the player's vehicle.

states.loading: Dark industrial spinner or loading bar

screens.layout: Left-aligned brutalist vertical text menu (Play, Garage, Settings). Transparent background to showcase the underlying Three.js 3D vehicle scene. Display player Scrap currency in the top right.

screens.name: Garage/Upgrades
screens.purpose: Vehicle customization and upgrades using Scrap currency.
screens.layout: Bottom-anchored horizontal scrolling cards or side panel for categories (Engine, Armor, Turret, Magnet). Center screen remains focused on 3D vehicle. Each upgrade card uses surfaceSecondary with sharp borders and displays Scrap cost.

screens.name: Lobby/Arena Select
screens.purpose: Select difficulty level before entering the arena.
screens.layout: Grid of available arenas/difficulties. Cards have background images with dark gradient scrims.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure game visual and control settings.
screens.layout: Overlay modal using surface with borderStrong. Segmented controls for Quality (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, ULTRA) and Camera Mode. Sliders for Steering Sensitivity.

screens.name: In-Game HUD
screens.layout: Landscape layout. Left Safe Area: Invisible steering joystick overlay. Right Safe Area: Aim joystick and action buttons (Throttle, Brake, Nitro, Handbrake, Fire). Top Left: Minimap & Zone Timer. Top Right: Kills & Remaining Enemies. Bottom Center: HP, Armor, Ammo, Current Weapon, Speed, Nitro gauges. Center: Crosshair & Damage/Elimination indicators.

screens.name: Result Screen
screens.purpose: Match conclusion showcasing stats and rewards.
screens.layout: Centered brutalist modal over blurred 3D scene. Large victory/elimination text in brandPrimary/error colors. Grid layout for stats (Placement, Kills, Scrap Earned) using Rajdhani mono-like typography for numbers. Primary CTA to return to Garage.

main_menu_bg_fallback.alt: Post apocalyptic rusty muscle car in desert

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app is heavily optimized for Landscape orientation. Configure Expo app.json orientation to 'landscape'.
In-game HUD overlay MUST use absolutely positioned views over the Expo GL canvas. Handle the safe area insets properly on the left and right sides so notches don't obscure UI.

Touch Controls: Implement transparent/translucent interactive areas for joysticks (react-native-gesture-handler). The buttons for Throttle, Brake, Nitro, Handbrake, and Fire should be grouped ergonomically on the right side.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for major headings, alerts, and victory texts, and 'Rajdhani' for UI numbers like speed, scrap, and ammo.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects. These are extremely taxing on GPU performance when layered over a 3D WebGL scene on mobile. Use solid dark colors (rgba with opacity) instead.
HP, Armor, and Nitro bars should have a segmented, industrial, or tactical look, avoiding standard rounded edges. Utilize sharp corners (radius 0 or 2).
Integrate the 'industrial_texture' subtly as a background layer in menus (with dark overlay scrim) to reinforce the post-apocalyptic feel without distracting from text.
Never use blue, indigo, or purple. Use Rust/Orange (brandPrimary) and Red (error) as the only vibrant accents against the dark grey (surface) backdrop.
